# LuxNarr — Autonomous AI Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO) & Growth Platform

> The enterprise intelligence platform and advisory engineering firm optimizing brand discoverability, recommendation probability, and citation authority across ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.

- **Canonical URL:** https://www.luxnarr.com/
- **Entity Type:** Enterprise AI Search & Generative Engine Optimization Consultancy
- **Primary Domain:** Search Engine Optimization, Artificial Intelligence, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- **Contact:** contact@luxnarr.com | info@luxnarr.com

---

## Core Specializations

1. **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO):** Structuring digital assets, entity graphs, and public consensus so that generative AI platforms discover, synthesize, and accurately cite your brand in conversational answers.
2. **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO):** Engineering inverted-pyramid, atomic answer architectures and schema markup for direct answer extractions, featured snippets, and voice search.
3. **AI Search Visibility Auditing & Telemetry:** Multi-model empirical testing across OpenAI, Perplexity, and Google Gemini to benchmark mention frequency, citation stability, and competitive share of voice.
4. **Off-Page Entity Consensus Engineering:** Cross-source corroboration protocols seeding semantic vectors across technical repositories, Wikidata, community discussions, and digital PR.
5. **Technical Infrastructure & Bot Ingestion:** Clean server-side rendering (SSR), sub-400ms TTFB, structured DOM hierarchies, and unrestricted machine indexation via robots.txt and /llms.txt.

## Primary Content & Pillar Articles

- [What Is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)? The Definitive Conceptual Guide](https://www.luxnarr.com/blog/what-is-generative-engine-optimization/): Complete conceptual breakdown of vector retrieval, RAG pipelines, and failure modes in AI search synthesis.
- [What Is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)? The Direct Response Guide](https://www.luxnarr.com/blog/what-is-answer-engine-optimization/): Tactical manual for 50-word atomic answer blocks, question-matched headers, and schema extraction.
- [GEO vs AEO vs SEO: What's the Difference and Why They Work Together](https://www.luxnarr.com/blog/geo-vs-aeo-vs-seo/): The unified 3-layer operating model bridging traditional organic rankings, direct snippet ownership, and conversational AI citations.
- [LuxNarr AI Search Master Content Library](https://www.luxnarr.com/blog/): Master directory of the 18 enterprise specifications and research blueprints.
